c.v: The pins with RTC functions are controlled by RTC_IO_TOUCH/RTC_PAD
By default all bits in these registers are set to 0, routing all input/output signals via IO MUX.
_MUX_SEL is set to 1, then input/output signals to and from that pin is routed to the RTC subsystem.
_REG is used to control RTC low power pins.
_REG applies the RTC GPIO pin numbering, not the GPIO pin numbering.
See Table 6.13-1 for RTC functions of RTC IO MUX pins.
